title: HomeworkDefaults
description: course/assessments/homework-defaults.yaml — the teacher's learned homework defaults (homework module, HW-D16). Read by homework-planner and /class-kit:plan-homework; updated when a homework is approved as built. Optional: created by `classkit scaffold homework` (HW-D13). Cross-file checks (at least one positive count, classes exist, estimated work fits the budget) are the rule `homework_defaults_consistent`, not this schema.

total_minutes.description: Default time budget for a homework, in minutes. Same bound as the manifest's `total_minutes`.

default_class_counts.description: Number of items per Item Class in an ordinary (non-versioned) homework (HW-D27). Keys are class names from item-classes.yaml; the item total is the sum. A class added with /class-kit:new-item-class starts at 0. Checked by `homework_defaults_consistent`.

allowed_tools.description: Default tools, by key from course.yaml's `tools` map (HW-D03).

reuse_policy.description: never = always fresh items; practice = reuse only for practice homework; always = reuse for any purpose.

budget_tolerance_minutes.description: How far the sum of item minutes may drift from `total_minutes` before `homework_budget_fits` warns.

misconception_candidate_threshold_pct.description: For a homework from a quiz report: misconceptions at or above this percentage of students are listed for the teacher to choose from (HW-D34). It only selects candidates; it never creates homework items by itself.
